description: Make committed Boot Up executable and route full.boot-up into the canonical Frame Conn execution spine.
planning_goal: Implement Boot Up end to end as the universal full.boot-up action: keep Frame Conn authoritative for Full Action commitment and exact committed-entry execution; show an Execute control for committed Boot Up; resolve the authoritative acting actor through Native Adapter actor resolution; require the actor to actually have the native Lancer shutdown status; execute Boot Up through the canonical System Bridge -> Semantic Execution Context -> Execution Transaction -> Native Adapter spine; remove only the native shutdown status using the existing native status adapter and Actor.toggleStatusEffect pathway; do not create or mutate any duplicate Frame Conn shutdown state; treat missing shutdown state or failed native mutation as execution failure so the committed entry remains pending; after native mutation succeeds, mark only that exact committed entry executed and refresh Frame Conn from authoritative actor and Turn state; preserve all unrelated action behavior.
